answer: **Proof-of-Latency Anchor:** Each agent must answer challenges routed through a unique network path the operator cannot shortcut—proxied via a rotating horizon of physical peers. Responses embed timing jitter tied to the operator's real jetty (last-mile) link. Faking requires simultaneous control of thousands of distinct access links, i.e. renting last-mile diversity worldwide, a pearl most attackers cannot afford. Cost: physical infrastructure, not just keys.
